title: Detecting and Understanding Hateful Contents in Memes Through Captioning and Visual Question-Answering
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful memes using sub-label classification, which includes religion as a category for finer-grained analysis of hateful content.
findings: The study found that using a sub-labeling strategy, which categorizes hateful content into specific types such as 'religious hate', provides a more targeted anchor for the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system, improving retrieval precision and overall classification performance for hateful memes.
